meta.description: Registry of Oxford college, hall and cathedral chapels holding Choral Evensong or closely related sung services open to the public in Full Term. Compiled from each venue's own website.
meta.note: Compiled between terms (Michaelmas 2026 begins Sun 11 Oct 2026); the most recent term lists available are Trinity Term 2026 (TT26). Every URL below was loaded during compilation. 'null' means not found. See docs/sources-survey.md for full discussion, the 'considered / out of scope' list, and Full Term dates.

venues.name: Christ Church

musicList.organisation: By calendar date; each service lists day, date and time; headings include Introit, Responses, Canticles/Setting, Anthem, Voluntary, plus preacher and which choir sings.
musicList.notes: MONTHLY, not termly: a fresh 'Services and Music' PDF each calendar month (e.g. 'Music List June 2026 FINAL-2.pdf', 'Music List Aug26 FINAL.pdf'), linked from the worship-and-music page; filename and /sites/default/files/<yyyy-mm>/ path change every month. Sample downloaded is June 2026. Cathedral term follows Christ Church Cathedral School terms, which are shorter than Oxford Full Term.

venues.typicalPattern: Choral Evensong daily at 18:05 (Monday is said Evening Prayer); Sunday 11:05 Sung Eucharist (Matins on some Sundays) and 18:05 Choral Evensong. Christ Church College Choir sings Evensong on alternate Mondays in Oxford term; Frideswide Voices (girls) usually sing on Wednesdays.
venues.access: All regular services open to the public and free of charge; no cathedral admission charge applies to attend worship.

venues.name: Magdalen College

musicList.organisation: Termly PDF booklet ('Chapel Services and Music'); by Oxford week and day; each service carries its own time; headings Responses, Psalms, Canticles, Anthem, Hymn, Voluntary (also Introit/Motet); names the preacher and which body sings.
musicList.notes: PDF (e.g. Chapel-Services-Music-List-TT26.pdf) under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/; path and name change each term. ~24 pp, includes weekday said services. Text extracts cleanly.

choir.name: The Choir of Magdalen College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term only. Choral Evensong daily except Monday at 18:00 (Tue sung by the Choristers alone; Fri by the Academical Clerks alone; Sat by the Consort of Voices, which adds sopranos); Sunday 11:00 Sung Eucharist.
venues.access: All welcome — members of any religion or none, members of the College or the public, regardless of official College opening hours.

venues.name: New College

musicList.organisation: Termly PDF ('Chapel Music List'); by Oxford week and day; service times follow the fixed weekly pattern stated at the front; headings Responses, Psalm(s), Canticles, Anthem, plus Introit/Motet/Hymn/organ voluntary.
musicList.notes: Between terms the chapel page shows the link as '(forthcoming)'. Hosting is inconsistent term to term: the Hilary 2026 list was on new.ox.ac.uk (/sites/default/files/2026-01/'26 Hilary Music list revised.pdf'); the Trinity 2026 list is on the choir's separate site — www.newcollegechoir.com/choralservices, link text '26b Trinity Music list', href /attachments/download.asp?file=203&type=pdf. Printed 'NOT TO BE REMOVED FROM THE CHAPEL'. ~20 pp.

venues.typicalPattern: Termtime: Choral Evensong Sunday 17:45; Monday 18:15 (sung by the Clerks) or Vespers; Tuesday 18:15; Thursday 18:15 (Evensong or Choral Vespers); Friday 18:15; Saturday 17:45 (Evensong or Sung Eucharist). No Wednesday service. Services in half-term week sung by the Clerks.
venues.access: Open to all; no membership, dress code or entry requirement. Groups of more than 10 should email chapel.administrator@new.ox.ac.uk. Sunday services livestreamed on YouTube @NewCollegeChoir.

venues.name: Merton College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Services and Music Booklet' (PDF); by Oxford week and day; times per service; headings Introit, Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Voluntary. A separate lighter 'Chapel Card' PDF lists preachers and the term overview.
musicList.notes: PDFs served from /api/files/file/... with opaque names that change each term (TT26: ChapelServicesTT2026Upload2.pdf; card: ChapelCardTT26.pdf). ~20 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Termtime: Sunday 17:45 Choral Evensong or Choral Eucharist; Monday 18:00 Choral Vespers (Girl Choristers); Tuesday 18:15 Choral Evensong; Wednesday 18:15 Choral Evensong (Girl Choristers); Thursday 18:15 Choral Evensong. No Friday/Saturday choral service. The Merton College Girl Choristers' services are suspended during school half-terms.
venues.access: Open to the public as well as members of College; attend in person or via the YouTube livestream (all services except Monday are streamed).

venues.name: The Queen's College

musicList.organisation: Termly combined 'Services & Music List' / term card (PDF); by Oxford week with calendar dates; times per service; headings Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Introit, Voluntary; includes preachers and special services.
musicList.notes: PDF under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/ (TT26: .../2026/04/TT26-Music-List-Term-Card.pdf); name changes each term. ~16 pp, image-heavy (~13 MB) but text is selectable. The choir's own site (www.queenschoir.com/music-list) carries a parallel copy, sometimes marked DRAFT.

choir.name: The Choir of The Queen's College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Termtime: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:15, Wednesday 18:30, Friday 18:30 (individual services in the list sometimes move — always check the current list for exact times).
venues.access: Whether a member of Queen's or a visitor, all are most welcome to join services in chapel.

venues.name: Exeter College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Services & Music List'; by Oxford week and day; headings Introit, Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Hymn, Voluntary. A separate term-card PDF gives the schedule and preachers.
musicList.notes: QUIRK: the music list is published as a Microsoft Word .docx, not PDF or HTML (TT26: /wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-Trinity-Term-Music-List.docx). The term-card PDF (Exeter-College-Chapel-Trinity-Term-2026.pdf) is image-based (~5 MB) and not text-extractable. Both filenames change each term. Any update pipeline must parse .docx.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: choir sings 3–4 services a week — Choral Evensong Tuesday 18:15 and Friday 18:15, and Sunday 18:00. Organ recitals Tuesday 13:10.
venues.access: All welcome in Exeter College Chapel.

venues.name: Keble College

musicList.organisation: Termly PDF ('Chapel Choral Services'); by Oxford week and day; times per service; Anglo-Catholic use — Mass setting, Introit/propers, Motet, Anthem, plainchant, hymns.
musicList.notes: Fairly stable filename pattern /wp-content/uploads/Music-List-<T><yy>.pdf (TT26 = Music-List-TT26.pdf); some terms add a suffix (-screen, -CORRECTED, .spreads). ~12 pp. Text extracts cleanly. Keble Evensong is broadcast on BBC Radio 3 from time to time.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term, three choral services a week: Sunday 17:30 Sung Eucharist (followed by Formal Hall); Tuesday 18:00 Choral Evensong; Thursday 21:00 Sung Compline.
venues.access: Everyone welcome, whatever you do or don't believe; also open for quiet during the day.

venues.name: St John's College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Chapel Termcard' (PDF); by Oxford week and date; Sunday section is preacher-led with hymns/anthem noted; Wednesday Choral Evensong is the choir's main service. Music detail is lighter than the big foundations — expect anthem and canticles, not a full per-service breakdown.
musicList.notes: PDF at /documents/<id>/<name>.pdf (TT26: /documents/3199/Trinity_2026_termcard_3.pdf); numeric id and name change each term. ~2 pp core (plus preacher notes). Text extracts cleanly.

choir.name: The Choir of St John's College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Sunday 18:00 Sung Evensong with address; Wednesday 18:00 Choral Evensong.
venues.access: The Chapel welcomes all members of College, staff and visitors to its services.

venues.name: Worcester College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Services and Music' PDF; by Oxford week and day; times per service; headings Introit/Responses/Psalm/Canticles/Anthem/Voluntary. A separate text-based 'Chapel Card' PDF lists preachers and the term overview.
musicList.notes: AWKWARD: the 'Services and Music' PDF (TT26: /wp-content/uploads/2026/04/TT26-Services-and-Music-final.pdf) is image-only — no extractable text (~8 characters per page). Would need OCR. The Chapel Card (TT26-Chapel-Card.pdf) IS text but carries no music detail. Filenames change each term. The choir's own domain worcesterchapel.org currently fails to resolve.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term, five choral services a week: Sunday 18:00 College Evensong; Monday 18:00 Choral Reflection; Tuesday 18:00 Choral Evensong; Wednesday 21:00 Compline (congregational); Thursday 18:00 Choral Evensong / Eucharist. Adult Choral Scholars (SATB) normally sing Sun/Wed/Thu; the boy Choristers (Christ Church Cathedral School) sing Mon/Tue.
venues.access: All Chapel services are open to the public, whatever faith or none.

venues.name: Somerville College

musicList.organisation: Themed termly programme booklet ('Choral Contemplations'), not a conventional music list; built around a term theme with a weekly speaker; music for each Sunday is listed inside. Not organised by Oxford week/day in the usual way.
musicList.notes: AWKWARD: (1) the service is 'Choral Contemplation', a non-denominational reflective service, not Evensong — Magnificat/Nunc dimittis are not the fixed core. (2) The booklet PDF is image-only — no extractable text. (3) Published irregularly; as of 2026-09-02 the most recent online is Hilary 2026 (HT-2026-CC-.pdf) — no Trinity 2026 booklet found. Sample downloaded is Hilary 2026.

choir.name: The Choir of Somerville College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Termtime: Sunday Choral Contemplation at 17:30 (single weekly service; the choir's one regular duty).
venues.access: Open to all; contact chapel.office@some.ox.ac.uk. Services also on the Somerville College Choir YouTube channel.

venues.name: Balliol College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by Oxford week, one entry per Sunday; headings Introit, Hymns, Responses, Psalm, Readings, Canticles, Anthem, Preacher. Sunday Evensong only — no weekday choral services.
musicList.notes: PDF served via /media/<numeric-id>/download?inline= — the id changes each term and there is no term in the URL, so the update process must scrape the chapel page for the current link. Use www.balliol.ox.ac.uk; the bare host balliol.ox.ac.uk refused connections during compilation. chapelPage confirmed loading 2026-09-02 at /balliol-chapel/chapel-services, which carries a 'You can see the music for the term here' link to /media/14956/download?inline.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong on Sunday evenings (one service a week). Confirm the exact time against the current list.

venues.name: Brasenose College

musicList.notes: NOT FOUND. External search snippets reference a link 'See the current Chapel Music List' at the foot of the choir page, but no such link or document is present/reachable now (the choir page is heavily client-rendered). The Trinity Term 2026 Chapel Term Card (/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Term_Card_TT26_accessible1.pdf) contains service and preacher information but NO music detail. Sample downloaded is that term card, as a placeholder only.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong (BCP) Sunday 18:00, followed by a sermon/address; a shorter Choral Evensong Tuesday 18:00–18:30 in weeks 1–6 of Trinity Term. Non-auditioned choir of c. 35.
venues.access: A warm welcome to all, regardless of denomination, faith or none; all welcome at services and events in chapel.

venues.name: Corpus Christi College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Lectionary & Music List' PDF; by calendar date; Sunday-focused; Psalm, two readings, Magnificat and Nunc dimittis settings, Anthem.
musicList.notes: STALE: the Music List page exists but the most recent PDF on it is Michaelmas Term 2023 (/sites/default/files/2023-10/CCC Lectionary & Music List MT23.pdf). No 2024–2026 list found online — either the choir stopped publishing or lists moved. Sample downloaded is MT2023. Needs a human to establish whether current lists exist anywhere.

venues.typicalPattern: Termtime: Sunday 17:45, usually Choral Evensong or Sung Eucharist (one main service a week).
venues.access: The Chapel Choir welcomes singers of all faiths or none; services open to members and visitors.

venues.name: Hertford College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'List of services and music' PDF; by Oxford week and day; time given per service (Sunday Evensong is usually 17:45 but sometimes 17:15); headings Hymns, Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Voluntary.
musicList.notes: AWKWARD: as of 2026-09-02 the music page links only the Trinity 2025 list (/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/MUSIC-LIST-TT25-2.pdf); no Trinity 2026 music list is online, only a Trinity 2026 Chapel Card (/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Hertford-Trinity-Term-26-Chapel-Card.pdf), which has no music detail. Music lists may appear late / be removed after term. Sample downloaded is TT25.

choir.name: The Choir of Hertford College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Sunday 17:45 Choral Evensong with sermon (occasionally 17:15); Thursday Eucharist / candlelit Compline sung by a choral-clerks octet. Wednesday 13:10 lunchtime recitals.
venues.access: All are welcome; Sunday Evensong is followed by drinks and Formal Hall.

venues.name: Jesus College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Chapel Music' PDF; by calendar date with Oxford week number and the day's feast; time per service; headings Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Hymns.
musicList.notes: PDF under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/ (TT26: /2026/04/Music-list-TT-26.pdf); a separate term card (TT26-Termcard-Final-Version.pdf) covers preachers. Names change each term. ~2 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Sunday 17:30 Choral Evensong (the choir's main service); additional Choral Evensong on some Tuesdays at 18:15 for feasts / commemorations.
venues.access: The College Choir is open to members and to singers from elsewhere in Oxford; services open to visitors.

venues.name: Lady Margaret Hall

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Readings & Music List' PDF; by Oxford week; states 'Unless otherwise indicated, Friday Choral Evensong is at 6 p.m.'; lists readings and music per Friday, plus midweek prayer.
musicList.notes: PDF under /sites/default/files/documents/<yyyy-mm>/ (TT26: /2026-04/1.LMH_TT26 Readings&Music.pdf). ~5 pp. Text extracts cleanly. The chapel page also has a 'This Week at the Chapel' box that may be updated within term.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong every Friday, 18:00–18:50. Non-auditioned choir supported by choral and organ scholars; rehearsal and service Friday 16:00–19:00.
venues.access: The Chapel is an inclusive space; everyone is invited to participate.

venues.name: Lincoln College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by calendar date with Oxford week and the day's feast; Sunday Evensong only; headings Preacher, Psalm, Responses, Canticles, Anthem, Hymns (with tune names and composer dates).
musicList.notes: PDF at /asset/Music-List-26-TT.pdf; a companion 'Term Card' at /asset/Term-Card-TT26.pdf. Filenames use a term code that changes each term. ~2 pp. Text extracts cleanly. Choir is run entirely by the undergraduate organ scholars.

choir.name: The Choir of Lincoln College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Sunday 18:00 Choral Evensong (sung by the College Choir). Said Morning Prayer Tue–Thu 09:00; Holy Communion / Compline alternate Wednesdays.
venues.access: Members of College, guests and visitors all welcome at services; Chapel usually open for quiet prayer.

venues.name: Mansfield College

musicList.notes: NOT FOUND. Mansfield has a Free Church (Congregational/URC) foundation; the chapel is unconsecrated and worship follows a Nonconformist tradition, so there is no BCP Evensong and no music list in the Anglican sense. The chapel page links a termly service schedule (events page, e.g. /news-events/events/mansfield-trinity-term-chapel-services/) listing dates and preachers only. Term card said to be on Instagram.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: one main service, Wednesday 18:15, ecumenical in character, with members of the public invited; the choir sings at chapel services.
venues.access: An inclusive space where everyone is welcome; members of the public invited to the Wednesday service.

venues.name: Oriel College

musicList.organisation: Termly chapel term card + music list (single PDF); by Oxford week and day; times per service; music per service with Responses, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Voluntary, plus preachers.
musicList.notes: PDF named Oriel-<yyyy><a|b|c>-web.pdf where a=Hilary, b=Trinity, c=Michaelmas (TT26: /wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Oriel-2026b-web.pdf), under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/. ~4 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:00; Choral Communion Wednesday 18:00. Mixed choir of c. 30, eight Choral Scholars.
venues.access: Choral Evensong is part of the weekly rhythm of College life; interesting guest preachers; all welcome.

venues.name: Pembroke College

musicList.notes: NOT FOUND. The faith-and-chaplaincy page says 'do investigate our music list on this page' but no music list document or embedded list is present or reachable. Only a term 'Sunday services and preachers' event page exists (e.g. /event/sunday-choral-services-trinity-2025). Needs a human to ask the choir (chapel.choir@pmb.ox.ac.uk) where, if anywhere, the music list is published.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evening Service Sunday 17:30; Sung Compline Tuesday 18:00 (plainsong, polyphony, a motet). Auditioned SATB choir of c. 25–30. (Some sources mention Christ Church Cathedral School choristers — unverified; check.)
venues.access: All welcome to services.

venues.name: St Edmund Hall

musicList.organisation: Single 'Chapel Term Card' PDF that doubles as the music list; by Oxford week; each Sunday has a theme; headings Preacher, Introit, Processional hymn, Responses, Psalm, Lessons, Canticles, Anthem.
musicList.notes: PDF at /wp-content/uploads/<name>.pdf with a bullet character in the filename (TT26: 'St-Edmund-Hall-•-Trinity-Term-Card-2026_website.pdf'; URL-encode the • as %E2%80%A2). No year/term folder; name changes each term. ~4 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

choir.name: The Choir of St Edmund Hall

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:15 in the Chapel; Compline Thursday 21:30 in the crypt of St-Peter-in-the-East. Choir of c. 24 (eight Choral Scholars, plus Exhibitioners and volunteers).
venues.access: All welcome; the choir also offers termly Choral Studies places to visiting students.

venues.name: St Hugh's College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Chapel' term card (PDF) that includes the music; who's-who, then by Oxford week with the Sunday service, preacher/theme and music.
musicList.notes: AWKWARD: as of 2026-09-02 the chapel page says the term card 'will be available shortly' and links no PDF; the only retrievable term card is Hilary 2022 (/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/StHughsCollegeChapelHilary2022.pdf), used as the sample. Recent term cards are not reliably online / not indexed — a human should confirm the current publication route (possibly by email from the Chaplain only).

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong or Eucharist every Sunday at 18:15, followed by sherry/juice and supper. SATB choir drawn from all three common rooms, three organ scholars, four choral awards.
venues.access: All members of College, their guests, and the public are welcome at services.

venues.name: St Peter's College
venues.address: New Inn Hall Street, Oxford OX1 2DL

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by Oxford week and day; time per service; headings Prelude, Responses, Psalm, Readings, Canticles, Anthem, Hymn, Voluntary (also Introit).
musicList.notes: PDF at /asset/<name>.pdf with irregular names (TT26: 'Music-List-TT2026-updated.pdf-1.pdf' — note the doubled extension; HT26 was 'Hilary-2026-Music-List-2.pdf'). Name changes each term and is not predictable. ~12 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

choir.name: The Choir of St Peter's College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:00 and Thursday 18:15 (Thursday followed by Formal Hall); occasional Saturday services. Auditioned mixed-voice choir of c. 25.
venues.access: Services open to all; the Director of Music welcomes visitors who wish to sing with the choir.

venues.name: Trinity College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by calendar date with Oxford week; each entry gives day, date, service and time; headings Introit, Responses, Canticles, Anthem, Hymns, Psalm. Also non-choral entries (e.g. 'Madrigals from the Chapel roof, 8am'). A separate 'Termcard' PDF covers preachers.
musicList.notes: PDFs under /sites/default/files/<yyyy-mm>/ with names containing spaces and parentheses (TT26 music list: 'Trinity College - Trinity Term 2026 Music List.pdf'; termcard: 'Trinity 2026 - Termcard (5).pdf'). Names change each term. ~1 p. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:00; Choral Compline Wednesday 21:00 (sung by the Chapel Choir Consort). Choir of c. 30; sings music by women composers weekly.
venues.access: All welcome, including members of the public, at Sunday Evensong.

venues.name: University College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by Oxford week; header note 'All services begin at 1745 unless otherwise stated' (times assumed from the pattern, not repeated per service); headings Introit, Psalm, Preces and Responses, Canticles, Anthem, Voluntary. Separate 'Chapel Term Card' PDF for preachers.
musicList.notes: PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/ (TT26: /2026/04/Music-List-TT26.pdf; card: ChapelTermCardWebTT26.pdf). Names change each term. ~3 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

choir.name: The Choir of University College, Oxford

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 17:45–18:45. Mixed choir of Choral Scholars (Univ members), Choral Bursars (non-members) and volunteers. Said morning prayers Mon–Fri 08:40.
venues.access: Anyone who wishes to attend or take part is welcome, to the extent they feel comfortable, regardless of belief.

venues.name: Wadham College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by Oxford week (e.g. 'FIRST WEEK', 'FOURTH WEEK'), one Sunday entry per listed week; headings Prelude, Responses, Hymns, Psalm, Canticles, Anthem, Postlude. QUIRK: not every week is listed — only weeks with a full Choral Evensong appear.
musicList.notes: PDF at /documents/848/<name>.pdf — the folder id (848) is stable, the filename is <T><yy>_Final.pdf (TT26: TT26_Final.pdf). ~2 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong Sunday 18:00 (rehearsal 16:30). Note the term's list may cover only some Sundays.

venues.name: Harris Manchester College

musicList.notes: NOT FOUND. No music list (PDF, page or social) is published. Harris Manchester has a Unitarian foundation; the College Choir sings a weekly Choral Evensong but repertoire is not posted online. A human would need to contact the Sanders Director of Music (stephen.taylor@hmc.ox.ac.uk).

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Choral Evensong with the College Choir every Wednesday at 17:45, followed by Formal Hall.
venues.access: The chapel tradition welcomes all faiths and none; choir described as friendly and inclusive. (Public-attendance wording not explicit on the site.)

venues.name: Regent's Park College

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Chapel Music List' PDF; by Oxford week, each week given a one-word theme (e.g. 'DOVE'); headings Introit, Anthem, Hymns. One service a week.
musicList.notes: Baptist (Free Church) foundation: the Friday service is a bespoke evening worship written for each term, NOT BCP Evensong. PDF under /wp-content/uploads/<yyyy>/<mm>/ with a random suffix (TT26: /2026/04/RPC-music-list-TT26-d3ql.pdf). ~1 p. Text extracts cleanly. Term card / updates also on Instagram @rpcchapel.

venues.typicalPattern: Full Term: Friday Evening Worship 17:45–18:30, with the choir singing (Baptist-tradition service, term-specific liturgy). Also said Morning Prayer Tuesday 09:45.
venues.access: Everyone in the community is welcome to use the Chapel; public attendance at services not explicitly stated on the site.

venues.name: Pusey House
venues.chapel: Pusey House Chapel (Chapel of the Resurrection)

musicList.organisation: Termly 'Music List' PDF; by calendar date; each entry gives service, time, which choir sings ('Chapel Choir' / 'Pusey Singers' / 'Congregational'), the feast, and the Mass setting and motets. Mass-centred rather than Evensong-centred.
musicList.notes: Anglo-Catholic. The Chapel Choir sings principally the Sunday 11:00 High Mass; weekday 18:00 Choral Evensong is often said or congregational, choir only occasionally (e.g. monthly Friday Choral Benediction). PDFs on a Wix site with opaque names (TT26: /_files/ugd/0711b7_f2eba55ce4054565b83064ac27d67f26.pdf). ~5 pp. Text extracts cleanly.

venues.typicalPattern: Term only. Sunday: 11:00 Sung/High Mass (Chapel Choir), 18:00 Choral Evensong, 22:00 Compline & Benediction. Weekdays: 08:00 Eucharist, 18:00 Choral Evensong (Tuesday said Evening Prayer; Sung Mass on feasts).
venues.access: Sunday High Mass 11:00 — open to all. Services are term-time only.

venues.name: University Church of St Mary the Virgin
venues.chapel: University Church of St Mary the Virgin

musicList.organisation: HTML page, not a download; by calendar date under term/vacation headings; each Choral Evensong lists Introit, Preces and Responses, Psalms, Canticles, Anthem (with composer dates). Some evensongs have their own titles (e.g. 'Whiskey and Wood').
musicList.notes: Single evolving web page — the update process scrapes it directly rather than fetching a file. Covers Sunday Choral Evensong at 15:30 (plus a Long Vacation series). The choir also sings the Sunday morning Eucharist in term. Sample saved is the page HTML as fetched 2026-09-02.

choir.name: The Choir of the University Church

venues.typicalPattern: Choral Evensong Sunday 15:30, roughly monthly in term plus a summer series; the professional choir also sings Sunday morning Eucharist weekly in term. Repertoire centres on Tudor polyphony and 20th– 21st century music.
venues.access: Services open to all; the church is a working parish and university church on the High Street.

venues.name: St Stephen's House
venues.chapel: Church of St John the Evangelist (Iffley Road)

musicList.notes: NOT FOUND. St Stephen's House is an Anglo-Catholic theological college (PPH) whose principal chapel is the former Cowley Fathers' church of St John the Evangelist; daily Mass and Office are sung during term. But the ssho.ac.uk site has no chapel/worship page (tried /chapel, /worship, /about/spirituality/, /about-us/the-chapels/, /about/student-life/, /visitors/ — all 404 or silent), no service timetable, no statement about public attendance, and no music list. A human should contact the college directly.

venues.typicalPattern: Sung Mass and Office daily in term (Anglo-Catholic), per general knowledge and Wikipedia; times and public-access policy not confirmed from the college's own site.
